correctness.rationale: For iid Exp(lambda), n>=2, G_n and unbiased S_n^2 are normalized degree-two U-statistics with kernels h(x,y)=|x-y| and q=(x-y)^2/2. From index-overlap counts Cov= [2 c2 + 4(n-2)c1]/[n(n-1)]. Standard exp |X-Y|~Exp(1); same-pair c2=2. Independent SymPy integrations confirm conditional kernels a(x)=x-1+2e^-x and b(x)=x²/2-x+1 satisfy Ea=Eb=1, Eab=7/4 so c1=3/4, Var(a)=1/3, Var(b)=2. Same-pair kernel variances 1 and 5 yield exact Cov=(3n-2)/[n(n-1)lambda^3], Var(G)=2(2n-1)/[3n(n-1)lambda²], Var(S²)=2(4n-3)/[n(n-1)lambda^4]. Divide to obtain rho=sqrt(3)(3n-2)/(2sqrt((2n-1)(4n-3))), increasing because independent SymPy factorization rho²(n+1)-rho²(n)=3(6n²-4n-1)/[4(2n-1)(2n+1)(4n-3)(4n+1)]>0; limit 3sqrt6/8. Only unnormalized pairwise Gini mean difference, not mean-normalized Gini coefficient; ordinary iid sample, no general-law universality.

evidence: General overlap identity Cov(U_h,U_q)=[2 c2+4(n-2)c1]/[n(n-1)] applies broadly, but requires distribution-specific mixed c1.
